# Eidos (@sweidos/eidos)

> Never lose a write. Durable client mutations for unreliable networks.

## Start

- [Start here](https://sweidos.vercel.app/docs/start): install, wrap, first Save
- [Never lose a save](https://sweidos.vercel.app/docs/save): neverLose actions + idempotency
- [Read offline](https://sweidos.vercel.app/docs/read): resource() caching
- [When things break](https://sweidos.vercel.app/docs/safety): offline, reload, crash, server duties
- [Recipes](https://sweidos.vercel.app/docs/recipes): copy-paste patterns
- [API cheat sheet](https://sweidos.vercel.app/docs/api): compact reference
- [Advanced](https://sweidos.vercel.app/docs/advanced): SW, conflict, codegen, testing

## Try

- [Try it](https://sweidos.vercel.app/try): live offline-first demo
- [Actions lab](https://sweidos.vercel.app/actions): queue inspector
- [Resources lab](https://sweidos.vercel.app/resources): cache inspector
